# Sound Cocktail

> Sound Cocktail is a free sound-therapy listening site. Tune 22 sounds — rain, fire, café voices, night train, piano — into a mix for the moment you are in, and save it for sleep, focus or unwinding. No app to install, no account needed to listen.

## Pages

## Curated soundscapes (film + editable listening)

- [Chiang Mai Focus Soundscape](https://soundcocktail.app/en/scenes/chiang-mai-focus): Royal Park Rajapruek moving footage with an original, adjustable focus composition. It is **not** rainy café interior footage or local café audio.
- [清迈 · 花园里的专注音景](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/scenes/chiang-mai-focus): 清迈皇家花园实景航拍与可调配原创音乐；并非雨中咖啡馆实拍或现场收音。
- [Bali Sound Bath & Rice Terrace Film](https://soundcocktail.app/en/scenes/bali-sound-bath): Credited Bali rice terrace aerial film, combined with original bowl-inspired soundscape; not a spa recording or clinical therapy.
- [巴厘岛 · 梯田声浴](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/scenes/bali-sound-bath): 巴厘岛梯田实景航拍与独立原创声浴；并非 SPA 实录，也不作医疗承诺。
- [Hoi An Lantern River Evening Soundscape](https://soundcocktail.app/en/scenes/hoi-an-evening): Credited moving footage of Hoi An's lantern-lit river paired with independently produced ambient music (Plus journey).
- [会安 · 灯笼河畔夜色音景](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/scenes/hoi-an-evening): 会安灯笼河道实景移动影像与原创音乐（进阶旅程）。
- [Sound Studio](https://soundcocktail.app/en/studio): Browser-based audio-layer editing, volume, mute, solo and shareable mixes. This is a tool route (noindex), not an editorial article.

- [Sound Cocktail](https://soundcocktail.app/en): Sound therapy, mixed for the moment you are in — focus, sleep, meditation — with real places to look at while you listen. 22 sounds, live recordings, instrument samples and live synthesis. Save mixes as recipes and share them.
- [Sound Cocktail （中文）](https://soundcocktail.app/zh): 免费的音疗聆听站：22 种声音，随意搭配、存成配方，助眠或专注都用得上。
- [Sound Therapy for Sleep · Rain & Night Sounds](https://soundcocktail.app/en/sleep): Steady rain, a little piano and wind — the most-saved mix for sleep.
- [助眠音疗 · 雨声与夜晚声音](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/sleep): 稳定的雨声、一点钢琴和风，最多人保存的助眠配方。
- [Sound Therapy for Focus · Deep Work & Study](https://soundcocktail.app/en/focus): Café voices, keyboard taps and a little guitar for deep work and studying.
- [专注音疗 · 深度工作与学习](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/focus): 咖啡馆人声、键盘轻敲和一点吉他，陪你深度工作与学习。
- [Guided Wind-Down · Sound Therapy for Relaxation](https://soundcocktail.app/en/relax): Fire, wind and a little piano — slow sounds for the last hour of the day.
- [放松音疗 · 睡前放慢的仪式](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/relax): 篝火、风和一点钢琴，给一天最后一小时的慢声音。
- [Rain Sounds for Meditation · Sound Therapy](https://soundcocktail.app/en/rain): Rain on a window with a stream underneath — the plainest mix, and the most-played.
- [雨声冥想 · 音疗](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/rain): 窗边的雨，下面一条溪流，站里最简单、也最多人听的配方。
- [Café Sounds for Writing · A Quiet Room of Your Own](https://soundcocktail.app/en/cafe): Low voices, keyboard taps and a little piano — a café where nobody bothers you.
- [咖啡馆写作音 · 属于自己的安静房间](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/cafe): 低声交谈、键盘轻敲和一点钢琴，那种没人打扰你的咖啡馆的声音。
- [About Sound Cocktail](https://soundcocktail.app/en/about): Made by one independent developer. How the sounds were made, what it costs, and what it is not.
- [关于 Sound Cocktail](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/about): 一个独立开发者的作品：声音是怎么来的、多少钱、它不是什么。
- [Sound recipes](https://soundcocktail.app/en/recipes): Free ambient sound recipes for sleep, focus and rain — open any one and make it yours.
- [声音配方](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/recipes): 助眠、专注与雨声的免费声音配方——打开任意配方，调成你的。
- [Sound Cocktail Plus](https://soundcocktail.app/en/plus): Subscription: all six destinations, unlimited listening, the full tuner and the sleep timer. $7.99/month, $79.90/year (¥18/month, ¥180/year in China). 7-day free trial on overseas subscriptions.
- [Sound Cocktail 进阶](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/plus): 订阅：全部六个目的地、不限时收听、完整调音与睡眠定时。月付 $7.99 / ¥18，年付 $79.90 / ¥180。海外订阅含 7 天免费试用。
- [Sources & licences](https://soundcocktail.app/en/sources): Where every sound comes from — real recordings, instrument samples and live synthesis, with authors and licences.
- [音源与授权](https://soundcocktail.app/zh/sources): 每个声音的出处：真实录音、乐器采样与实时合成，附作者与授权说明。

## Sound Cocktail Plus (subscription)

- Monthly ($7.99 / ¥18): all six destinations, unlimited listening, the full tuner, saved mixes and the sleep timer.
- Yearly ($79.90 / ¥180): the same, for a year. Overseas subscriptions include a 7-day free trial; domestic Alipay cards are one-time purchases with no trial.
